name: job_get
title: Inspect Job
description: Reads the lifecycle state of a server job created by an earlier tool call (for example client_update returns a job_id). Use to poll long-running operations to completion instead of guessing. Read-only; the job_id is correlation-safe to store. Jobs are tenant-scoped: ids from other tenants behave as not found.

job_id.description: Server job handle returned by an earlier tool call.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

job_id.description: Echo of the inspected job handle.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Terminal states never change again.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
